hero.title: About Trivlu
hero.subtitle: Making group travel effortless, one adventure at a time.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.p1: Trivlu was born from a simple frustration: planning group trips shouldn't be harder than the trip itself. We believe that bringing people together for shared adventures should be seamless, exciting, and stress-free.
mission.p2: Our AI-powered platform takes the chaos out of coordinating multi-traveler experiences. From selecting destinations to building custom itineraries, Trivlu handles the logistics so you can focus on making memories.

adventure.title: Adventure First
adventure.body: We curate destinations and activities that create unforgettable experiences for groups of all sizes.

stress.title: Zero Stress
stress.body: Our smart trip builder handles the complexity of group coordination so you don't have to.

together.title: Better Together
together.body: Travel is best when shared. We design every feature to bring groups closer together.

story.title: Our Story
story.p1: It started with a weekend trip that almost didn't happen. Too many group chats, conflicting preferences, and last-minute cancellations nearly derailed what should have been a simple getaway.
story.p2: That experience sparked an idea: what if there was a platform that made planning group adventures as fun as the adventures themselves? Trivlu is the answer — the first AI-powered trip maker built specifically for multi-traveler experiences.
